IFNULL(na.total_calories, 0.0) AS calories, IFNULL(na.total_carbs, 0.0) AS carbs, IFNULL(na.total_protein, 0.0) AS protein, IFNULL(na.total_fat, 0.0) AS fat, na.foods_json AS aiComment, CASE WHEN na.status IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE CAST(na.status AS CHAR) END AS status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VIDEOS (user_id, team_id, meal_type, meal_date, video_url, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{mealType}, #{mealDate}, #{videoUrl}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT , , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl WHERE vl.video_id = v.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl2 WHERE vl2.video_id = v.id AND vl2.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked FROM VIDEOS v JOIN USERS u ON v.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.team_id = #{teamId} AND v.meal_date = #{mealDate}

SELECT , , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl WHERE vl.video_id = v.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl2 WHERE vl2.video_id = v.id AND vl2.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked FROM VIDEOS v JOIN USERS u ON v.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.id IN ( SELECT picked.id FROM ( SELECT MAX(id) AS id FROM VIDEOS WHERE user_id = #{ownerId} AND meal_date = #{mealDate} GROUP BY meal_type ) picked ) ORDER BY FIELD(v.meal_type, 'BREAKFAST', 'LUNCH', 'DINNER'), v.meal_type

SELECT , , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl WHERE vl.video_id = v.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIDEO_LIKES vl2 WHERE vl2.video_id = v.id AND vl2.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked FROM VIDEOS v JOIN USERS u ON v.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN NUTRITION_ANALYSIS na ON v.id = na.video_id WHERE v.id = #{id}
